task_jobs_group_pair_check.name: task_jobs_group_pair_check
task_jobs_group_pair_check.value: ("task_jobs"."group_key" IS NULL AND "task_jobs"."group_order" IS NULL) OR ("task_jobs"."group_key" IS NOT NULL AND "task_jobs"."group_order" IS NOT NULL AND "task_jobs"."group_order" >= 0)

task_jobs_lease_state_check.name: task_jobs_lease_state_check
task_jobs_lease_state_check.value: ("task_jobs"."state" = 'running' AND "task_jobs"."claimed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "task_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "task_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("task_jobs"."state" <> 'running' AND "task_jobs"."claimed_by" IS NULL AND "task_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "task_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

task_jobs_completion_state_check.name: task_jobs_completion_state_check
task_jobs_completion_state_check.value: ("task_jobs"."state" IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "task_jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("task_jobs"."state" IN ('pending', 'running') AND "task_jobs"."completed_at" IS NULL)

voice_agent_session_observers_terminal_h.name: voice_agent_session_observers_terminal_handling_check
voice_agent_session_observers_terminal_h.value: "voice_agent_session_observers"."terminal_handled_at" IS NULL OR "voice_agent_session_observers"."terminal_sequence" IS NOT NULL

voice_agent_session_observers_transcript.name: voice_agent_session_observers_transcript_handling_check
voice_agent_session_observers_transcript.value: ("voice_agent_session_observers"."transcript_status" = 'pending' AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."transcript_handled_at" IS NULL) OR ("voice_agent_session_observers"."transcript_status" IN ('admitted', 'skipped') AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."transcript_handled_at" IS NOT NULL)

voice_agent_session_observers_failure_me.name: voice_agent_session_observers_failure_metadata_check
voice_agent_session_observers_failure_me.value: ("voice_agent_session_observers"."consecutive_failures" = 0 AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."last_failure_kind" IS NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."last_failure_operation" IS NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."last_failure_at" IS NULL) OR ("voice_agent_session_observers"."consecutive_failures" > 0 AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."last_failure_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."last_failure_operation" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."last_failure_at" IS NOT NULL)

voice_agent_session_observers_lease_comp.name: voice_agent_session_observers_lease_complete
voice_agent_session_observers_lease_comp.value: ("voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

voice_agent_session_observers_exhaustion.name: voice_agent_session_observers_exhaustion_check
voice_agent_session_observers_exhaustion.value: ("voice_agent_session_observers"."status" = 'exhausted' AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."exhausted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("voice_agent_session_observers"."status" <> 'exhausted' AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."exhausted_at" IS NULL)

voice_agent_session_observers_signal_che.name: voice_agent_session_observers_signal_check
voice_agent_session_observers_signal_che.value: "voice_agent_session_observers"."exhaustion_signaled_at" IS NULL OR "voice_agent_session_observers"."exhausted_at" IS NOT NULL

voice_agent_session_observers_finalizati.name: voice_agent_session_observers_finalization_check
voice_agent_session_observers_finalizati.value: "voice_agent_session_observers"."status" NOT IN ('finalizing', 'completed') OR ("voice_agent_session_observers"."terminal_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_agent_session_observers"."terminal_handled_at" IS NOT NULL)

voice_agent_session_observers_terminal_l.name: voice_agent_session_observers_terminal_lease_check
voice_agent_session_observers_terminal_l.value: ("voice_agent_session_observers"."status" NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') OR "voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_owner" IS NULL) AND ("voice_agent_session_observers"."status" <> 'exhausted' OR "voice_agent_session_observers"."exhaustion_signaled_at" IS NULL OR "voice_agent_session_observers"."lease_owner" IS NULL)

voice_agent_session_pointers_grant_ident.name: voice_agent_session_pointers_grant_identity_complete
voice_agent_session_pointers_grant_ident.value: ("voice_agent_session_pointers"."grant_id" IS NULL AND "voice_agent_session_pointers"."grant_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("voice_agent_session_pointers"."grant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_agent_session_pointers"."grant_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

voice_agent_session_pointers_revocation_.name: voice_agent_session_pointers_revocation_requires_grant
voice_agent_session_pointers_revocation_.value: "voice_agent_session_pointers"."grant_revoked_at" IS NULL OR "voice_agent_session_pointers"."grant_id" IS NOT NULL

voice_webhook_sources_sequence_check.name: voice_webhook_sources_sequence_check
voice_webhook_sources_sequence_check.value: ("voice_webhook_sources"."source_kind" = 'session_event' AND "voice_webhook_sources"."worker_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_webhook_sources"."worker_sequence" >= 1) OR ("voice_webhook_sources"."source_kind" IN ('transcript', 'observer_failure') AND "voice_webhook_sources"."worker_sequence" IS NULL)
